desks.headline: Cherag's Rayan could decide top spot as Haaland waits
desks.text: Forest lead Man City 2-0 with 29 minutes gone, and Haaland has **just 1 point** with 21 managers waiting on his armband. Cherag sits top on 664 with **Rayan** still to play, the only one of you who owns him, while Ayodele is 9 back and needs Haaland to fire. Hishaan's Barry has already hauled 32 points for Hishaan alone, and Edd and Hishaan are joint 7th with Omar just above them.

desks.headline: Rayan could decide top spot while Haaland waits on 1 point
desks.text: Haaland has **1 point** with 21 managers waiting on his armband, and Cherag sits top on 664. Only Cherag owns **Rayan** still to play, and he's **9 clear** of Ayodele, who needs Gomez and Gakpo to rescue him.

desks.headline: Cherki bites benchers as Cherag's Rayan eyes top spot
desks.text: Cherki has scored for **9 points** in NFO v MCI, while Nihal, Nanik and Dominic sit on the bench, and Elvin's armband is worth **18 points** to him. Cherag leads Ayodele by **8** at the top, with Rayan still to come for Cherag alone. Haaland's armband, shared by 21 managers, is the bigger question still to be answered.

desks.headline: Haaland blanks as 21 armbands go up in smoke
desks.text: Haaland blanked for **4 points** and **21 armbands went to waste**, so the 8 who went elsewhere just gained ground. Cherag still leads Ayodele by **8**, but Rayan is still to play for Cherag alone and could decide top spot if he fires.

desks.headline: Rayan could decide top spot as Cherag leads by 8
desks.text: Cherag leads Ayodele by **8** at the top, with **Rayan** still to play for Cherag alone, so one fixture could settle top spot. Ayodele needs **Gomez and Gakpo**, both still to play and both his alone, to haul himself back.

desks.headline: Rayan could settle top spot for Cherag
desks.text: Cherag still leads top spot by **8** over Ayodele, and Rayan, his captain, is still to play for him alone. Ayodele needs **Tavernier, Gomez and Gakpo**, all still to play and all his alone, to haul himself back. One result could settle it within about 2 hours.

desks.headline: Cherag's top spot hangs on Rayan's late fixture
desks.text: Cherag leads Ayodele by **8** at the top, with **Rayan** still to play for him alone, so one fixture could settle top spot. Ayodele needs Tavernier, Gomez and Gakpo, all his alone, to claw back. Haaland's blank has already wasted **21 armbands**, so the chase is wide open.

desks.headline: Rayan could settle top spot for Cherag tonight
desks.text: Cherag leads Ayodele by **8** at the top, and **Rayan**, his captain, is still to play for him alone, so one fixture could settle it. Ayodele's Haaland has already had his game, so he needs **Tavernier, Gomez and Gakpo**, all still to play and all his alone, to claw back.

desks.headline: Cherag and Ayodele fight for top spot as Rayan's fixture looms
desks.text: Top spot is still open: **Cherag leads Ayodele by 8**, with his captain **Rayan** still to play for him alone. Ayodele's Haaland has already returned just 4 points, so he needs **Tavernier, Gomez and Gakpo**, all yet to play, to claw back.

desks.headline: Evanilson scores and Raushan's lone captain pays off
desks.text: Evanilson has scored for IPS v BOU, and **Raushan** is the big winner, as his only captain he is collecting **10 captain points**. 13 managers started him, so **5 points** rattle the table, and Omar, one of 3 who bought him this week, cheers too.

desks.headline: Ayodele takes top spot as Gomez scores for him alone
desks.text: Ayodele takes top spot as **Gomez scores** for him alone, a differential haul that lifts him **8 clear of Cherag**. Rayan is still to play for Cherag, so one fixture could still narrow the gap. Ayodele's Haaland has already had his game, so the fight for the summit is now about Cherag's captain.

desks.headline: Ayodele holds top spot as Rayan plays for Cherag
desks.text: Top spot is still open, with **Ayodele 8 clear of Cherag**, whose captain Rayan is playing now. Ayodele's Haaland has already done his job, and Cherag still has 2 players to come, with Mbeumo among them. **Rayan's haul** will decide whether Cherag can close the gap before the summit settles.

desks.headline: Cherag's benched Groß scores as top spot tightens
desks.text: Cherag's bench call on **Groß** is haunting him, as the BHA v BRE man scores and collects **9 points** for those who started him. Cherag is **5 behind Ayodele** at the top, with Rayan still playing and Mbeumo still to come when MUN v AVL kicks off.

desks.headline: Sasha's Wirtz strike lands alone as captain Thiago blanks
desks.text: Sasha's lone **Wirtz** strike is the differential of the day, worth **8 points** while nobody else in the league gets a sniff. Ravi and Isaiah are celebrating Barcola's assist in CRY v LIV, but Sasha's captain Thiago is on **-2** in BHA v BRE.

desks.headline: Cherag's benched Groß scores as top spot tightens
desks.text: Cherag's benched Groß has scored, collecting **10 points** as BHA v BRE leads 2-0. Ayodele holds top spot on 688, **9 clear** of Cherag, whose Rayan is playing now. Mbeumo, the only player Cherag still has to come, could decide whether MUN v AVL closes that gap.

desks.headline: Sasha's lone Wirtz assist lands as Thiago blanks
desks.text: Sasha's **Wirtz** assist is worth **13 points**, and he is the only one in the league collecting them. Sasha's captain Thiago has blanked in BHA v BRE, so that Wirtz return is doing the heavy lifting. Saurabh's captain Isak, who scored in CRY v LIV, is paying off too.

desks.headline: Ayodele's top spot lead rests on MUN v AVL
desks.text: **Ayodele** leads on **689**, **10 clear** of Cherag, with one player still to come against Cherag's 2. Mbeumo is the one player Cherag alone still has to come, so when MUN v AVL kicks off the top spot could tighten.

desks.headline: Ayodele's top spot lead on the line as Mbeumo plays
desks.text: Ayodele leads on **690**, but Cherag sits **9 behind** with Rayan returning just 4 points, and MUN v AVL is live with Mbeumo on the pitch after Ayodele and Omar benched him. If Mbeumo starts firing, the top spot could tighten, so the lead is not yet settled.

desks.headline: N.Jackson scores as Ayodele's top spot lead holds
desks.text: **N.Jackson** has scored for Manchester United, delighting the 17 managers who started him. Ayodele holds top spot, **9 clear** of Cherag, whose captain Rayan has managed just 4 points. If Mbeumo, benched by Ayodele and Omar, starts firing, that lead could tighten.

desks.headline: Tonna's lone Fernandes goal rocks MUN v AVL
desks.text: **B.Fernandes** has scored for Manchester United, and only Tonna owns that **6 points**. Ayodele still leads on **696**, with Cherag **9 behind**, whose captain Rayan has 4 points. Cherag could close in if MUN v AVL keeps firing.

desks.headline: Ayodele holds top spot as Cherag's Rayan flops
desks.text: Ayodele sits on top with **694 points**, **9 clear** of Cherag, whose armband Rayan has managed just 4 points. MUN v AVL is live at 2-3, with B.Fernandes's goal owned only by Tonna, and Cherag could close in if benched Mbeumo, dropped by Ayodele and Omar, starts firing.

desks.headline: N.Jackson's assist keeps Ayodele on top, Cherag 8 back
desks.text: N.Jackson has set one up as Manchester United lead Aston Villa 2-4 with 64 minutes played, and his **11 points** land in 17 managers' teams. That keeps **Ayodele** on top on **700**, with Cherag **8 behind** on 692 and his Rayan captaincy managing just 4 points.

desks.headline: Fernandes's lone assist lifts Tonna as Ayodele holds top
desks.text: **B.Fernandes's** assist is the gameweek's sharpest knife, and only Tonna owns it, so his climb to 6th is all his. **Ayodele** still tops the table, with Cherag hunting him after Rayan's armband flopped. We said N.Jackson's haul could let **Bhavik** pass Ravi, and it did.

desks.headline: Dominic wins the week on 75 as Ayodele holds top spot
desks.text: **Dominic** won the week with **75**, the best score of the gameweek, while **Ayodele** still tops the table on 700, 8 clear of Cherag. Haaland blanked for 21 managers, and Hishaan's **Barry** armband hauled 32 to lift him 5 places to 9th. We said N.Jackson's haul could let Bhavik pass Ravi, and it did.

desks.headline: Haaland blanks on 21 armbands as Dominic wins the week
desks.text: **Haaland** blanked on 21 armbands, scoring just 4 points, while **Dominic** took the week's best score of 75. **Ayodele** moved to top on 700, 8 clear of Cherag, who slipped to 2nd. We said Bhavik could pass Ravi, and he did.

desks.headline: Dominic wins the week as Ayodele tops the table
desks.text: **Dominic** won the week on 75, while **Ayodele** finished top on 700, 8 clear of Cherag after Haaland blanked on 21 armbands. Hishaan's **Barry** haul of 32 lifted him 5 places to 9th. We said Tonna could pass Omar if Rogers blanked, and he did.

desks.headline: If Cherki hauls, Naishadh could pass Bhavik from 19 behind
desks.text: If **Cherki hauls** at home to FUL, Naishadh could pass Bhavik from 19 behind, though only 8 managers started him. Elvin is the one captaining Cherki, so a haul there is worth 20 on the armband, and **that's the swing that could change everything**.

desks.headline: Haaland goalless as 22 armbands sit on MCI v FUL
desks.text: **Haaland** is captained by **22 managers**, yet MCI v FUL is goalless and he has **0 points** so far. Ayodele leads on **700 points**, with Cherag **8 points** behind and also captaining Haaland, so the top spot rests on the players still to play.

desks.headline: Haaland on 22 armbands as MCI v FUL trails 0-1
desks.text: Haaland has **1 point** on 22 armbands as MCI v FUL trails **0-1** at 25 minutes, with Ayodele on **702 points** and Cherag **8 points** behind, both captaining him. The top spot now rests on the 10 players each still to play, and Ayodele's Robertson and Gomez could keep him ahead.

desks.headline: Haaland's 22 armbands yield 1 point as City trail
desks.text: Haaland's **22 armbands** have yielded **1 point** as MCI trail FUL **0-1** at half-time. Ayodele leads on **702 points**, 8 points clear of Cherag, and both captain him. With 10 players each still to play, Ayodele's Robertson and Gomez could decide the top spot.

desks.headline: Anderson scores 10 points, benched by Sasha
desks.text: **Anderson** has scored **10 points**, yet nobody in the league started him and Sasha benched him. Haaland has **2 points** on **22 armbands** at 1-1, and Ayodele leads Cherag by **8 points** with 10 players each still to play.

desks.headline: Haaland blanks as 22 armbands are wasted
desks.text: Haaland managed **2 points** on **22 armbands**, a blank that leaves MCI v FUL finished 1-1 with the top spot still open. **Ayodele** leads Cherag by **7 points**, 708 to 701, with Gomez and Gakpo still his alone to play.

desks.headline: Ravi sold Rudoni, who has just set one up
desks.text: Ravi sold **Rudoni** this week, and now Rudoni has an assist for **4 points** in COV v CRY at 1-1. Justin benched Pedro Porro, who has also assisted for **4 points**, while **Ayodele** still leads Cherag by **7 points** at the top.

desks.headline: Rogers assists as Haaland blanks on 22 armbands
desks.text: **Rogers** has assisted for 6 points, a windfall for the 24 managers who started him, while **Haaland** blanked on 22 armbands. At the top, **Ayodele** still leads Cherag by 14 points, with Gomez and Gakpo his alone to come.

desks.headline: Rudoni hauls 10 points after Ravi sold him
desks.text: Ravi sold **Rudoni** this week and benched him, and now the midfielder has **10 points** in COV v CRY, a sting for a manager sitting 14th. Dinesh's sale of Calvert-Lewin stings too, with the forward on **4 points** in CHE v LEE while Cherag and Saurabh watch from the bench.

desks.headline: Ravi's Tavernier sale backfires as he assists for 5 points
desks.text: Ravi sold **Tavernier** this week, and he has now assisted for **5 points** in BOU v NFO, with 16 managers starting him. Ayodele still leads Cherag by **17 points** at the top, and Evanilson's **7 points** in the same match could shift that race. NEWC v ARS is next.

desks.headline: Calvert-Lewin hauls 9 points after Dinesh sold him
desks.text: **Calvert-Lewin** has scored and assisted for **9 points** in CHE v LEE, a sting for Dinesh, who sold him this week, and for Cherag, who benched him. At the top, Ayodele leads Cherag by **18 points**, and benching Bogle, who has assisted for 4 points, is a talking point.

desks.headline: Haaland's 2 points leave Ayodele 11 clear at the top
desks.text: Haaland managed just **2 points** for the 22 managers who captained him, but **Ayodele** still leads Cherag by **11 points** at the top. Both have 5 players left, with Gomez and Gakpo the extra threats for Ayodele and Calafiori and Groß for Cherag.

desks.headline: Haaland blanks on 22 armbands as Ayodele keeps top spot
desks.text: Haaland managed just **2 points** for the 22 managers who captained him, yet **Ayodele** still leads Cherag by **12 points** at the top. Both have 5 players left, with Gomez and Gakpo the extra threats for Ayodele and Calafiori and Groß for Cherag.

desks.headline: Ayodele's 12-point cushion faces Newcastle v Arsenal test
desks.text: **Ayodele** leads **Cherag** by **12 points** at the top, 726 to 714, and both have Haaland, who managed just **2 points** across 22 armbands. Ayodele's extra threats are Gomez and Gakpo, while Cherag needs Calafiori and Groß to close the gap when NEWC v ARS kicks off.

desks.headline: Haaland blanks on 22 armbands as Ayodele keeps top spot
desks.text: Haaland returned just **2 points** on 22 armbands, yet Ayodele still leads Cherag by **11 points** at the top. Ayodele has Gomez and Gakpo still to play, while Cherag's hopes rest on Groß and Calafiori as NEWC v ARS plays on.

desks.headline: Ayodele's 11-point cushion hangs on Gomez and Gakpo
desks.text: Haaland managed just **2 points** across 22 armbands, yet Ayodele still leads Cherag by **11 points** at the top. Ayodele has 3 players still to play, including **Gomez and Gakpo**, who only his side owns, while Cherag has 2 left, with Groß his alone.

desks.headline: Barnes scores 8 after 4 managers benched him
desks.text: **Barnes scored 8 points** after 4 managers benched him: Sid, Nanik, Bhavik and Raushan. Sid sits 4th and Nanik 5th, just **2 points** apart, so that bench call could shape the Gold spots fight. With NEWC v ARS still in play, every point counts for those chasing the top.

desks.headline: Haaland blanks on 22 armbands as Ayodele holds top spot
desks.text: Haaland returned **2 points** on 22 armbands, yet Ayodele still leads Cherag by **11 points** at the top. Gomez and Gakpo are still to play and only Ayodele owns them, while Groß is Cherag's lone hope, so the top spot could tighten. NEWC v ARS is in play.

desks.headline: Ødegaard's assist lifts 5 managers as Haaland flops
desks.text: Ødegaard **assisted a goal for 6 points** while NEWC v ARS is still on at 2-2, and 5 managers started him. Haaland's armband returned just **2 points** from 22 armbands, leaving Ayodele **11 points** clear of Cherag at the top, with Gomez and Gakpo still to play for Ayodele alone.

desks.headline: Haaland blanks on 22 armbands as Ayodele holds top
desks.text: Haaland returned **2 points** on **22 armbands**, yet Ayodele still leads Cherag by **11 points** at the top. Gomez and Gakpo are still to play for Ayodele alone, while Groß is Cherag's lone hope, so the top spot could tighten.

desks.headline: Ayodele's 11-point lead, with Gomez and Gakpo still to play
desks.text: Ayodele holds top spot with an **11-point** lead over Cherag, after Haaland's armband returned just 2 points. Gomez and Gakpo are still to play and belong only to Ayodele, while Cherag's lone hope is Groß. The **top spot** could tighten once HUL v BHA kicks off.

desks.headline: Haaland blanks on 22 armbands as Ayodele holds top
desks.text: Haaland blanked on **22 armbands**, returning just **2 points**, yet Ayodele holds top spot with an **11-point lead** over Cherag. Gakpo is still to play and belongs only to Ayodele, so he could stretch that lead. Cherag has no players left, so he cannot close the gap.

desks.headline: Ayodele's top spot rests on Gakpo, Cherag has nothing left
desks.text: Ayodele holds top spot with **Gakpo** still to play for him alone, while Cherag sits **9 points** behind with no players left. Haaland's **2 points** on 22 armbands has left the table tight, and HUL v BHA is goalless, so Gakpo could stretch the lead or hold it.

desks.headline: Ayodele top with Gakpo to come, Haaland's armband flops
desks.text: Ayodele holds top spot with an **11-point lead** over Cherag, despite Haaland's armband returning just 2 points. Gakpo is still to play for Ayodele alone, and he could **stretch that lead**. Cherag has no players left, so he can only wait for LIV v MUN to kick off.

desks.headline: Belloumi assists after Tonna and Ahmad benched him
desks.text: Belloumi has **set up a goal** after Tonna and Ahmad benched him, while Tomisin, who started him, gains from it. At the top, Ayodele leads Cherag by **10 points** with **Gakpo** still to play for him alone. LIV v MUN could stretch that lead.

desks.headline: Szoboszlai scores, Isak assists as LIV v MUN starts
desks.text: Szoboszlai has scored for LIV v MUN, worth **6 points** to Justin, who started him. Isak has assisted, worth **4 points** to the 7 managers who started him, with Dinesh and Saurabh having captained him. At the top, Ayodele still leads Cherag by **10 points**.

desks.headline: Wirtz scores 8 points for a lone Sasha start
desks.text: Wirtz has scored and is worth **8 points**, but only Sasha started him, and Sasha is inactive. Meanwhile Szoboszlai has **9 points** in LIV v MUN, and Ayodele still leads Cherag by **10 points** at the top.

desks.headline: Szoboszlai's goal and Isak's assist put Liverpool 2-0 up
desks.text: **Szoboszlai has scored in LIV v MUN, worth 9 points** to the 3 managers who started him, and Isak has set one up, worth **4 points** to the 7 managers who started him. At the top, Ayodele still leads Cherag by **10 points**, and the 45 minutes left in that match could decide whether Liverpool's goals keep stretching the gap.

desks.headline: Ravi sold Barcola, Isaiah banks the assist
desks.text: Barcola has set one up, worth **5 points** to Isaiah, the only manager who started him. **Ravi sold Barcola this week**, so the assist lands on the transfer that went wrong. Isaiah sits 5 points behind Tobi in the fight to escape the **Tin Pot**.

desks.headline: Wirtz's assist worth 14 points to a lone, inactive Sasha
desks.text: Wirtz has set one up for **14 points**, but only Sasha started him, and Sasha is one of the inactive teams, so nobody actively chasing the league gets any of it. Meanwhile Liverpool lead Manchester United **4-0**, and at the top Ayodele still leads Cherag by **10 points**.

desks.headline: Ayodele's 10-point lead holds as Liverpool thump Man Utd
desks.text: **Szoboszlai's 9-point goal** and Isak's assist sent Liverpool to a 4-0 win, leaving Ayodele **10 points clear** of Cherag at the top. Both have finished, so that gap is set. Further down, Edd leads Ravi by **one point** in 8th, with Tarkowski still to play for Edd.

desks.headline: Tarkowski could decide Edd's one-point lead over Ravi
desks.text: When BRE v EVE kicks off, **Tarkowski** is the swing man: Edd, Saurabh, Elvin and Sasha started him, while Omar and IB benched him. Edd is **1 point** ahead of Ravi, and Ravi has no one left to play, so Tarkowski points could stretch Edd clear while Ravi waits.

desks.headline: Tarkowski on the pitch as Edd and Ravi fight
desks.text: BRE v EVE is goalless after 5 minutes, with Tarkowski already on **1 point**. Edd started him and sits **2 points** ahead of Ravi, who has no players left to play. If Tarkowski keeps adding points, **Edd** could stretch clear while Ravi waits.

desks.headline: Tarkowski on the pitch as Omar and Edd's call splits
desks.text: BRE v EVE is **2-0** after 31 minutes, and Tarkowski is still on 0 points, started by Edd and benched by Omar. Edd sits **1 point** ahead of Ravi, and Ravi has no players left to play, so Tarkowski's next points could decide whether Edd pulls clear.

desks.headline: Tarkowski sent off as Omar and IB's bench calls pay
desks.text: Tarkowski's **red card** in BRE v EVE, now 3-0 at 73 minutes, is the biggest swing of the gameweek and leaves him on **-3 points**. Omar and IB benched him and look smart, while Ravi and Hishaan are just **1 point** apart in the close battle for 8th and 9th.

desks.headline: Maanav's 58-point Bench Boost wins the gameweek outright
desks.text: **Maanav** won the week with **58 points** on a Bench Boost, while **Ayodele** still leads, now **11 points clear** of Cherag. Edd's 21 points earned The Doghouse and a drop to 10th. We called it: Maanav passed Raushan once N.Jackson blanked on 2 points.
